# Sensitivity analyses dataframes

### Merging hospitalization records when the admission day occurs on the same or next day as the prior discharge day

```{r}
#| label: no merged df 
#| echo: false
#| results: false

hospitalizations_no_merged <- hospitalization_main_df %>%
  dplyr::select(
    patient_uuid,
    admission_age_days_firstDate,
    admission_age_days_lastDate,
    seizure_related_admission,
    planned_admission,
    birth_admission,
    outpatient_admission
  )
```

#### Hospitalization occurs on the SAME day as the prior discharge day

```{r}
#| label: merging hospital admission records same day
#| echo: false
#| results: false

#' gap_threshold = 0 → next hospitalization record starts on the *same day (+0)*
#'  as the previous discharge (for the same patient and with the same type of
#'  sr diagnosis)

# 1. Apply the episode-flagging function across all gap thresholds
#' Note: the function developed is in function.R
hospital_admission_flag_same_day <- flag_admission_episodes(
  hospitalizations_no_merged,
  gap_threshold = 0
) # same day

# 2. Merge admissions within the same episode
#' Internal note: 2 more records could be merged by removing the seizure-type
#' condition for merging
hospitalization_merged_same_day <- hospital_admission_flag_same_day %>%
  # Keep only unplanned, non-birth admissions and inpatient admissions
  filter(
    birth_admission == 0 &
    planned_admission == 0 &
    outpatient_admission == 0) %>%
  group_by(
    patient_uuid, # by patient
    episode_id, # by episode identified earlier
    seizure_related_admission # and by seizure-related flag
  ) %>%
  # merge admissions within patient, same episode and seizure diagnosis type
  summarise(
    # earliest start in episode
    admission_age_days_firstDate = min(admission_age_days_firstDate),
    # latest end in episode
    admission_age_days_lastDate = max(admission_age_days_lastDate),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 3. re-run the count of readmissions with new merged records
# function explained in detail in function.R and main derivation above.
readmissions_sensit_same_day <- hospitalization_merged_same_day %>%
  dplyr::select(
    patient_uuid,
    admission_age_days_firstDate,
    admission_age_days_lastDate
  ) %>%
  find_readmissions(
    grouping = "patient_uuid",
    start_date = "admission_age_days_firstDate",
    end_date = "admission_age_days_lastDate"
  ) %>%
  arrange(patient_uuid, admission_age_days_firstDate)

# 4. re-derive count of 30-day UHRs per index admission with merged records
readmissions_sensit_same_day_counted <- readmissions_sensit_same_day %>%
  # Bring in deceased patient information
  left_join(deceased_patients, by = "patient_uuid") %>%
  # Bring last record age days to calculate last exposure time at risk
  left_join(
    rare_disease_followup_durations_days %>% dplyr::select(
      patient_uuid,
      last_record_age_days
    ),
    by = "patient_uuid"
  ) %>%
  #' Exclude admission record if a patient is deceased during the
  #' admission period, but retain prior ones for that patient
  filter(!(patient_uuid %in% deceased_patients &
    primary_diagnosis_age_days >= admission_age_days_firstDate &
    primary_diagnosis_age_days <= admission_age_days_lastDate)) %>%
  arrange(patient_uuid, admission_age_days_firstDate) %>%
  group_by(patient_uuid) %>%
  # identify 30-day readmissions for each index admission
  mutate(
    # flag index admissions based on readmission variable
    index_admission = if_else(readmission == "index", 1, 0),

    # create a sequential number for each index admission within patient
    index_number = cumsum(index_admission),

    # flag last index admission for each patient for last exptime derivation
    last_index = if_else(index_number == max(index_number), 1, 0),

    # flag 30-day readmissions
    is_uhr = str_detect(readmission, "30_days_uhr")
  ) %>%
  # Group by patient and index number
  group_by(patient_uuid, index_number) %>%
  mutate(
    # count readmissions for each index
    count_readmissions = sum(is_uhr, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  #  Keep only index admissions
  filter(index_admission == 1) %>%
  #' Define exposure time (exptime) for each index admission
  mutate(
    exptime = as.integer(
      case_when(
        last_index == 1 &
          (last_record_age_days - admission_age_days_lastDate < 30) ~
          last_record_age_days - admission_age_days_lastDate,
        TRUE ~ 30
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  #' Exclude exp time = 0 (i.e., last record == admission last day)
  filter(exptime > 0) %>%
  # order, rename and select variables of interest
  dplyr::select(
    patient_uuid,
    admission_age_days_firstDate,
    admission_age_days_lastDate,
    count_readmissions,
    exptime
  )

# 5. Joined dataframe with merged hospitalizations and readmissions
hospitalizations_sensit_same_day_joined <- purrr::reduce(
  list(
    hospitalization_merged_same_day,
    readmissions_sensit_same_day,
    readmissions_sensit_same_day_counted
  ),
  left_join,
  by = c(
    "patient_uuid",
    "admission_age_days_firstDate",
    "admission_age_days_lastDate"
  )
)

#' 6. join previously derived covariates (from main df) that do not change with
#'  the merging and depends only on the patient id and admission start day
#'  (not period dependent)
hospitalizations_sensit_same_day_joined_cov <- 
  hospitalizations_sensit_same_day_joined %>%
  left_join(
    hospitalization_main_df %>% dplyr::select(
      patient_uuid,
      sex,
      other_epilepsy_mutations,
      recurrent_variant,
      neonatal_onset,
      age_admission_yr,
      admission_age_days_firstDate,
      tech_assistance_ever,
      vns_insertion_ever,
      n_distinct_asm_admission
    ),
    by = c(
      "patient_uuid",
      "admission_age_days_firstDate"
    )
  )

#' 7. re-derive covariates that may change with new periods in merged records
#' (i.e. length of stay and adverse effects during hospitalization)

#' 7.a. LOHS and length of stay categories
admissions_sensit_same_day_lohs <- hospitalizations_sensit_same_day_joined_cov %>%
  mutate(
    length_of_stay_days =
      (admission_age_days_lastDate - admission_age_days_firstDate) + 1,
    length_of_stay_days_cat = cut(
      length_of_stay_days,
      quantile(length_of_stay_days, c(0:3 / 3)),
      include.lowest = TRUE,
      labels = c("Bottom", "Middle", "Top")
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    patient_uuid,
    admission_age_days_firstDate,
    admission_age_days_lastDate,
    length_of_stay_days,
    length_of_stay_days_cat
  )


#' 7.b. Respiratory support during admission
## -- derive first therapeutic procedures and clinical diagnoses
therapeutic_rec_same_day <- hospitalizations_sensit_same_day_joined_cov %>%
  # join therapeutic procedures with hospital admissions
  left_join(
    rare_disease_therapeutic_procedures,
    relationship = "many-to-many",
    by = "patient_uuid"
  ) %>%
  # compute overlap flags (either a date or an interval)
  mutate(
    procedure_overlap = if_else(
      !is.na(procedure_age_days_firstDate) &
        !is.na(procedure_age_days_lastDate) &
        !is.na(admission_age_days_firstDate) &
        !is.na(admission_age_days_lastDate) &
        (admission_age_days_firstDate <= procedure_age_days_lastDate) &
        (admission_age_days_lastDate >= procedure_age_days_firstDate),
      TRUE, FALSE
    ),
    # keep procedure name only if overlap
    procedure = if_else(procedure_overlap, procedure, NA_character_)
  ) %>%
  # group by admission
  group_by(
    patient_uuid,
    admission_age_days_firstDate,
    admission_age_days_lastDate
  ) %>%
  # summarise overlapping procedures (or NA if none)
  summarise(
    ther_procedure_name = str_c(
      unique(na.omit(procedure)),
      collapse = "; "
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # rename to procedure for binding rows with clinical diagnoses
  rename(procedure = ther_procedure_name) %>%
  arrange(
    patient_uuid,
    admission_age_days_firstDate
  )


## -- idenfity clinical diagnoses during admissions
clinical_diagnosis_same_day <- hospitalizations_sensit_same_day_joined_cov %>%
  # Joining clinical diagnosis with hospital admission by patient UUID
  left_join(
    rare_disease_clinical_diagnosis,
    relationship = "many-to-many",
    by = "patient_uuid"
  ) %>%
  # Boolean to determine if the procedure has an explicit period that matches the admission period
  mutate(

    #' Boolean to determine if the clinical diagnosis (procedure) has an
    #' explicit period that matches the admission period in at least one day
    procedure_overlap = if_else(
      !is.na(clinical_diagnosis_age_days_firstDate) &
        !is.na(clinical_diagnosis_age_days_lastDate) &
        !is.na(admission_age_days_firstDate) &
        !is.na(admission_age_days_lastDate) &
        (admission_age_days_firstDate <= clinical_diagnosis_age_days_lastDate) &
        (admission_age_days_lastDate >= clinical_diagnosis_age_days_firstDate),
      TRUE, FALSE
    ),
    clinical_diagnosis = if_else(
      procedure_overlap, clinical_diagnosis, NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  #' Filter to retain procedures at hospital admissions:
  #' either a single-day procedure falls within admission period
  #' or the procedure period overlaps with the admission period
  # filter(procedure_overlap) %>%
  # Group by patient and admission periods
  group_by(
    patient_uuid,
    admission_age_days_firstDate,
    admission_age_days_lastDate
  ) %>%
  # Concatenate distinct values into a single cell as temporary variable
  summarise(
    clinical_diagnosis = str_c(
      unique(na.omit(clinical_diagnosis)),
      collapse = "; "
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # rename to procedure for binding rows with therapeutic procedures
  rename(procedure = clinical_diagnosis) %>%
  arrange(patient_uuid, admission_age_days_firstDate)

## -- identify resp.support during admissions
admissions_sensit_same_day_resp_supp <- rbind(
  clinical_diagnosis_same_day,
  therapeutic_rec_same_day
) %>%
  # add a flag if procedure matches respiratory support terms
  mutate(
    respiratory_support_flag = case_when(
      str_detect(
        procedure,
        regex(str_c(RESP_SUPPORT_TERMS, collapse = "|"), ignore_case = TRUE)
      ) &
        !str_detect(
          procedure,
          regex("hypoventilation", ignore_case = TRUE)
        ) ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    )
  ) %>%
  # group by admission
  group_by(
    patient_uuid,
    admission_age_days_firstDate,
    admission_age_days_lastDate
  ) %>%
  # summarise as binary factor: "1" if any respiratory support, else "0"
  summarise(
   respiratory_support_admission = factor(
      any(respiratory_support_flag, na.rm = TRUE) * 1,
       levels = c(0, 1)
    ),
  .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(patient_uuid, admission_age_days_firstDate)

#' 7.c. adverse events during admissions
admissions_sensit_same_day_aes <- hospitalizations_sensit_same_day_joined_cov %>%
  # Join adverse effects episodes
  left_join(
    rare_disease_adverse_effects,
    by = "patient_uuid",
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    patient_uuid,
    admission_age_days_firstDate,
    admission_age_days_lastDate,
    adverse_effect,
    medication_procedure,
    adverse_effect_age_days_firstDate,
    adverse_effect_age_days_lastDate
  ) %>%
  # Boolean overlap: adverse event overlaps with admission
  mutate(
    adverse_effect_overlap = if_else(
      !is.na(adverse_effect_age_days_firstDate) &
        !is.na(adverse_effect_age_days_lastDate) &
        !is.na(admission_age_days_firstDate) &
        !is.na(admission_age_days_lastDate) &
        (adverse_effect_age_days_firstDate <= admission_age_days_lastDate) &
        (adverse_effect_age_days_lastDate >= admission_age_days_firstDate),
      TRUE, FALSE
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    patient_uuid,
    admission_age_days_firstDate,
    admission_age_days_lastDate
  ) %>%
  # Add binary variable (0/1) for adverse effect presence during admission
  # Note: for those admissions without AE, it was assumed no event (i.e., 0)
  summarise(
    adverse_effect_admission = factor(
      # if there is a match between the adverse effect and the admission
      # period, then it is an 1, otherwise 0
      any(adverse_effect_overlap, na.rm = TRUE) * 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )  

#' 7.d- ketogenic diet during admission

#' 7.d. ketogenic diet during admission
# a. Derivation of ketogenic diet during admission period for 30-day and lohs analyses
adm_keto_overlap_same_day <- hospitalizations_sensit_same_day_joined_cov %>%
  left_join(
    ketogenic_diet_episodes,
# Check for overlap between *effective* procedure window and admission
  #' any part of the period starting from day 14 to the end of the
  #' ketogenic treatment overlaps with the admission
    join_by(
      patient_uuid,
      overlaps(
        admission_age_days_firstDate,
        admission_age_days_lastDate,
        keto_effective_first_day,
        keto_effective_last_day
      )
    )
  ) %>%
    # Summarise as binary presence indicator per admission
  group_by(
    patient_uuid,
    admission_age_days_firstDate,
    admission_age_days_lastDate
  ) %>%
    #' Summarise a binary variable indicating was under ketogenic diet
  #'  for each hospital admission record (at least one day of match)
  summarise(
    #' if there is a match between the effective period of the
    #' ketogenic diet and the admission period, then it is an 1
    ketogenic_diet_admission = factor(any(!is.na(keto_effective_first_day)) * 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# b. Derivation of ketogenic diet at admission day for sr analysis
adm_keto_on_admday_same_day <- hospitalizations_sensit_same_day_joined_cov %>%
  left_join(
    ketogenic_diet_episodes,
    # Check for overlap between *effective* procedure window and admission
  #' any part of the period starting from day 14 to the end of the
  #' ketogenic treatment overlaps with the admission
    join_by(
      patient_uuid,
      between(admission_age_days_firstDate,
              keto_effective_first_day,
              keto_effective_last_day)
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    patient_uuid,
    admission_age_days_firstDate,
    admission_age_days_lastDate
  ) %>%
  #' Summarise a binary variable indicating was under ketogenic diet
  #'  for each hospital admission record (if there is a match at the day of admission)
  summarise(
    #' if the admission day is within the effective period, yes = 1, otherwise 0
    ketogenic_diet_at_admission_day = factor(any(!is.na(keto_effective_first_day)) * 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

admissions_sensit_same_day_keto <- adm_keto_overlap_same_day %>%
  left_join(
    adm_keto_on_admday_same_day,
    by = c(
      "patient_uuid",
      "admission_age_days_firstDate",
      "admission_age_days_lastDate"
    )
  )

#' 7.e. Quinidine during admission
#' a) Identify admissions with at least one day matching during admission episodr 
#' or at the day of admission match with quinidine use. 
quinidine_during_admission_rec_any_same_day <- hospitalizations_sensit_same_day_joined_cov %>%
  # Join hospital admissions and quinidine episodes on patient_uuid and overlap of periods
  left_join(
    quinidine_use_episodes,
    join_by(
      patient_uuid,
      overlaps(
        admission_age_days_firstDate,
        admission_age_days_lastDate,
        medication_age_days_firstDate,
        medication_age_days_lastDate
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  # Group by patient and admission periods
  group_by(
    patient_uuid,
    admission_age_days_firstDate,
    admission_age_days_lastDate
  ) %>%
  #' Summarise a binary variable indicating quinidine use for each hospital 
  #' admission record (at least one day of match)
  summarise(
    # if there is a match between the quinidine use and the admission
    # period, then it is an 1, otherwise 0
    quinidine_admission = factor(any(!is.na(medication_age_days_firstDate)) * 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#2.a identify admissions with quinidine already active on the admission day
quinidine_during_admission_rec_on_day_same_day <- hospitalizations_sensit_same_day_joined_cov %>%
  # Join hospital admissions and quinidine episodes where admission start is within the quinidine use period
  left_join(
    quinidine_use_episodes,
    join_by(
      patient_uuid,
      between(
        admission_age_days_firstDate,
        medication_age_days_firstDate,
        medication_age_days_lastDate
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  # Group by patient and admission periods
  group_by(
    patient_uuid,
    admission_age_days_firstDate,
    admission_age_days_lastDate
  ) %>%
  #' Summarise a binary variable indicating quinidine use at the admission day
  summarise(
    quinidine_at_admission_day = factor(any(!is.na(medication_age_days_firstDate)) * 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#2.b merge both variables into the final df (keep original name)
admissions_sensit_same_day_quinid <- quinidine_during_admission_rec_any_same_day %>%
  left_join(
    quinidine_during_admission_rec_on_day_same_day,
    by = c(
      "patient_uuid",
      "admission_age_days_firstDate",
      "admission_age_days_lastDate"
    )
  )

# 8- List of period-varying covariates to join
sensit_same_day_time_dfs <- list(
  admissions_sensit_same_day_lohs, # lohs and lohs categories
  admissions_sensit_same_day_resp_supp, # respiratory support variable
  admissions_sensit_same_day_aes, # adverse effects admission variable
  admissions_sensit_same_day_keto, # ketogenic diet admission variable
  admissions_sensit_same_day_quinid # quinidine use admission variable
)

# 9-Joining hospitalization-varying covariates for sensitivity analyses (same day)
admissions_sensit_same_day_full <- purrr::reduce(
  sensit_same_day_time_dfs,
  left_join,
  .init = hospitalizations_sensit_same_day_joined_cov, # start from prior joined df
  by = admission_join_var # based on start, end and patient uuid
)

# 10- Order variables in same way as in main df
#' Note. this dataframe can be used for all secondary endpoints, and for its use
#' in 30-day UHRss, the index in readmissions should be filtered.
admissions_sensit_same_day_full <- admissions_sensit_same_day_full %>%
  mutate(
    patient_uuid = as.factor(patient_uuid)
  ) %>%
  # select and order variables of interest in joined df
  dplyr::select(
    # patient identifier
    patient_uuid,
    # admissions related features
    admission_age_days_firstDate,
    admission_age_days_lastDate,
    # demographics
    sex,
    age_admission_yr,
    # follow up and disease onset
    neonatal_onset,
    # genetic mutations
    other_epilepsy_mutations,
    recurrent_variant,
    # clinical history
    seizure_related_admission,
    length_of_stay_days,
    length_of_stay_days_cat,
    respiratory_support_admission,
    tech_assistance_ever,
    readmission,
    count_readmissions,
    exptime,
    # treatment history
    vns_insertion_ever,
    n_distinct_asm_admission,
    adverse_effect_admission,
    ketogenic_diet_admission,
    ketogenic_diet_at_admission_day,
    quinidine_admission,
    quinidine_at_admission_day
  ) %>%
  # arrange by patient uuid and admission day
  arrange(patient_uuid, admission_age_days_firstDate)
```

#### Hospitalization occurs on the NEXT day as the prior discharge day

```{r}
#| label: admissions-merged-episodes-nextday
#| echo: false
#| results: false
#' gap_threshold = 1 → next hospitalization record starts on the *next day (+1)*
#'  after the previous discharge (for the same patient and with the same type
#'   of sr diagnosis)

# 1. Apply the episode-flagging function across all gap thresholds
#' Note: the function developed is in function.R
hospital_admission_flag_next_day <- flag_admission_episodes(
  hospitalizations_no_merged,
  gap_threshold = 1
) # next day

# 2. Merge admissions within the same episode
#' Internal note: 4 more records could be merged if removing the seizure-type
#' condition for merging
hospitalization_merged_next_day <- hospital_admission_flag_next_day %>%
  # Keep only unplanned, non-birth admissions
  filter(
    birth_admission == 0 &
    planned_admission == 0 &
    outpatient_admission == 0) %>%
  group_by(
    patient_uuid, # by patient
    episode_id, # by episode identified earlier
    seizure_related_admission # and by seizure-related flag
  ) %>%
  # merge admissions within patient, same episode and seizure diagnosis type
  summarise(
    # earliest start in episode
    admission_age_days_firstDate = min(admission_age_days_firstDate),
    # latest end in episode
    admission_age_days_lastDate = max(admission_age_days_lastDate),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 3. Re-run the count of readmissions with new merged records
readmissions_sensit_next_day <- hospitalization_merged_next_day %>%
  dplyr::select(
    patient_uuid,
    admission_age_days_firstDate,
    admission_age_days_lastDate
  ) %>%
  find_readmissions(
    grouping = "patient_uuid",
    start_date = "admission_age_days_firstDate",
    end_date = "admission_age_days_lastDate"
  ) %>%
  arrange(patient_uuid, admission_age_days_firstDate)

# 4. re-derive count of 30-day UHRs per index admission with merged records
readmissions_sensit_next_day_counted <- readmissions_sensit_next_day %>%
  # Bring in deceased patient information
  left_join(deceased_patients, by = "patient_uuid") %>%
  # Bring last record age days to calculate last exposure time at risk
  left_join(
    rare_disease_followup_durations_days %>% dplyr::select(
      patient_uuid,
      last_record_age_days
    ),
    by = "patient_uuid"
  ) %>%
  #' Exclude admission record if a patient is deceased during the
  #' admission period, but retain prior ones for that patient
  filter(!(patient_uuid %in% deceased_patients &
    primary_diagnosis_age_days >= admission_age_days_firstDate &
    primary_diagnosis_age_days <= admission_age_days_lastDate)) %>%
  arrange(patient_uuid, admission_age_days_firstDate) %>%
  group_by(patient_uuid) %>%
  # identify 30-day readmissions for each index admission
  mutate(
    # flag index admissions based on readmission variable
    index_admission = if_else(readmission == "index", 1, 0),

    # create a sequential number for each index admission within patient
    index_number = cumsum(index_admission),

    # flag last index admission for each patient for last exptime derivation
    last_index = if_else(index_number == max(index_number), 1, 0),

    # flag 30-day readmissions
    is_uhr = str_detect(readmission, "30_days_uhr")
  ) %>%
  # Group by patient and index number
  group_by(patient_uuid, index_number) %>%
  mutate(
    # count readmissions for each index
    count_readmissions = sum(is_uhr, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  #  Keep only index admissions
  filter(index_admission == 1) %>%
  #' Define exposure time (exptime) for each index admission:
  #' Use 30 days as default  unless censored earlier for last index admission
  mutate(
    exptime = as.integer(
      case_when(
        last_index == 1 &
          (last_record_age_days - admission_age_days_lastDate < 30) ~
          last_record_age_days - admission_age_days_lastDate,
        TRUE ~ 30
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  #' Exclude exp time = 0 (i.e., last record == admission last day),
  #' as there is no time to follow up after last index admission
  filter(exptime > 0) %>%
  # order, rename and select variables of interest
  dplyr::select(
    patient_uuid,
    admission_age_days_firstDate,
    admission_age_days_lastDate,
    count_readmissions,
    exptime
  )

# 5. Joined dataframe with merged hospitalizations and readmissions
hospitalizations_sensit_next_day_joined <- purrr::reduce(
  list(
    hospitalization_merged_next_day,
    readmissions_sensit_next_day,
    readmissions_sensit_next_day_counted
  ),
  left_join,
  by = c(
    "patient_uuid",
    "admission_age_days_firstDate",
    "admission_age_days_lastDate"

)

  summarise(
   respiratory_support_admission = factor(
      any(respiratory_support_flag, na.rm = TRUE) * 1,
       levels = c(0, 1)
    ),
  .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(patient_uuid, admission_age_days_firstDate)

#' 7.c. adverse effect during admissions
admissions_sensit_next_day_aes <- hospitalizations_sensit_next_day_joined %>%
  # Join adverse effect episodes
  left_join(
    rare_disease_adverse_effects,
    by = "patient_uuid",
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    patient_uuid,
    admission_age_days_firstDate,
    admission_age_days_lastDate,
    adverse_effect,
    medication_procedure,
    adverse_effect_age_days_firstDate,
    adverse_effect_age_days_lastDate
  ) %>%
  # Boolean overlap: adverse effect overlaps with admission
  mutate(
    adverse_effect_overlap = if_else(
      !is.na(adverse_effect_age_days_firstDate) &
        !is.na(adverse_effect_age_days_lastDate) &
        !is.na(admission_age_days_firstDate) &
        !is.na(admission_age_days_lastDate) &
        (adverse_effect_age_days_firstDate <= admission_age_days_lastDate) &
        (adverse_effect_age_days_lastDate >= admission_age_days_firstDate),
      TRUE, FALSE
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    patient_uuid,
    admission_age_days_firstDate,
    admission_age_days_lastDate
  ) %>%
  # Add binary variable (0/1) for adverse effect presence during admission
  # Note: for those admissions without AE, it was assumed no event (i.e., 0)
  summarise(
    adverse_effect_admission = factor(
      # if there is a match between the adverse effect and the admission
      # period, then it is an 1, otherwise 0
      any(adverse_effect_overlap, na.rm = TRUE) * 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )  

#' 7.d. ketogenic diet during admission
# a. Derivation of ketogenic diet during admission period for 30-day and lohs analyses
adm_keto_overlap_next_day <- hospitalizations_sensit_next_day_joined %>%
  left_join(
    ketogenic_diet_episodes,
# Check for overlap between *effective* procedure window and admission
  #' any part of the period starting from day 14 to the end of the
  #' ketogenic treatment overlaps with the admission
    join_by(
      patient_uuid,
      overlaps(
        admission_age_days_firstDate,
        admission_age_days_lastDate,
        keto_effective_first_day,
        keto_effective_last_day
      )
    )
  ) %>%
    # Summarise as binary presence indicator per admission
  group_by(
    patient_uuid,
    admission_age_days_firstDate,
    admission_age_days_lastDate
  ) %>%
    #' Summarise a binary variable indicating was under ketogenic diet
  #'  for each hospital admission record (at least one day of match)
  summarise(
    #' if there is a match between the effective period of the
    #' ketogenic diet and the admission period, then it is an 1
    ketogenic_diet_admission = factor(any(!is.na(keto_effective_first_day)) * 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# b. Derivation of ketogenic diet at admission day for sr analysis
adm_keto_on_admday_next_day <- hospitalizations_sensit_next_day_joined %>%
  left_join(
    ketogenic_diet_episodes,
    # Check for overlap between *effective* procedure window and admission
  #' any part of the period starting from day 14 to the end of the
  #' ketogenic treatment overlaps with the admission
    join_by(
      patient_uuid,
      between(admission_age_days_firstDate,
              keto_effective_first_day,
              keto_effective_last_day)
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    patient_uuid,
    admission_age_days_firstDate,
    admission_age_days_lastDate
  ) %>%
  #' Summarise a binary variable indicating was under ketogenic diet
  #'  for each hospital admission record (if there is a match at the day of admission)
  summarise(
    #' if the admission day is within the effective period, yes = 1, otherwise 0
    ketogenic_diet_at_admission_day = factor(any(!is.na(keto_effective_first_day)) * 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

admissions_sensit_next_day_keto <- adm_keto_overlap_next_day %>%
  left_join(
    adm_keto_on_admday_next_day,
    by = c(
      "patient_uuid",
      "admission_age_days_firstDate",
      "admission_age_days_lastDate"
    )
  )

#' 7.e. Quinidine during admission

#2. identify admissions with matching use of quinidine in at least one day
#   (using inequality join with overlaps)

#' a) Identify admissions with at least one day matching during admission episodr 
#' or at the day of admission match with quinidine use. 
quinidine_during_admission_rec_any_next_day <- hospitalizations_sensit_next_day_joined %>%
  # Join hospital admissions and quinidine episodes on patient_uuid and overlap of periods
  left_join(
    quinidine_use_episodes,
    join_by(
      patient_uuid,
      overlaps(
        admission_age_days_firstDate,
        admission_age_days_lastDate,
        medication_age_days_firstDate,
        medication_age_days_lastDate
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  # Group by patient and admission periods
  group_by(
    patient_uuid,
    admission_age_days_firstDate,
    admission_age_days_lastDate
  ) %>%
  #' Summarise a binary variable indicating quinidine use for each hospital 
  #' admission record (at least one day of match)
  summarise(
    # if there is a match between the quinidine use and the admission
    # period, then it is an 1, otherwise 0
    quinidine_admission = factor(any(!is.na(medication_age_days_firstDate)) * 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#2.a identify admissions with quinidine already active on the admission day
quinidine_during_admission_rec_on_day_next_day <- hospitalizations_sensit_next_day_joined %>%
  # Join hospital admissions and quinidine episodes where admission start is within the quinidine use period
  left_join(
    quinidine_use_episodes,
    join_by(
      patient_uuid,
      between(
        admission_age_days_firstDate,
        medication_age_days_firstDate,
        medication_age_days_lastDate
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  # Group by patient and admission periods
  group_by(
    patient_uuid,
    admission_age_days_firstDate,
    admission_age_days_lastDate
  ) %>%
  #' Summarise a binary variable indicating quinidine use at the admission day
  summarise(
    quinidine_at_admission_day = factor(any(!is.na(medication_age_days_firstDate)) * 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#2.b merge both variables into the final df (keep original name)
admissions_sensit_next_day_quinid <- quinidine_during_admission_rec_any_next_day %>%
  left_join(
    quinidine_during_admission_rec_on_day_next_day,
    by = c(
      "patient_uuid",
      "admission_age_days_firstDate",
      "admission_age_days_lastDate"
    )
  )

# 8- List of time-varying covariates to join
sensit_next_day_time_dfs <- list(
  admissions_sensit_next_day_lohs, # lohs and lohs categories
  admissions_sensit_next_day_resp_supp, # respiratory support variable
  admissions_sensit_next_day_aes, # adverse effect admission variable
  admissions_sensit_next_day_keto, # ketogenic diet admission variable
  admissions_sensit_next_day_quinid # quinidine use admission variable
)

# 9- joining hosptialization-varying covariates for sensitivity analyses (next day)
admissions_sensit_next_day_full <- purrr::reduce(
  sensit_next_day_time_dfs,
  left_join,
  .init = hospitalizations_sensit_next_day_joined_cov, # start from previos joined
  by = admission_join_var # based on start, end and patient uuid
)

#10- order variables in same way as in main df
#' Note: this dataframe can be used for all secondary endpoints, and for its use
#' in 30-day UHRss, the index in readmissions should be filtered.
admissions_sensit_next_day_full <- admissions_sensit_next_day_full %>%
  # select and order variables of interest in joined df
  mutate(
    patient_uuid = as.factor(patient_uuid)
  ) %>%
  # select and order variables of interest in joined df
  dplyr::select(
    # patient identifier
    patient_uuid,
    # admissions related features
    admission_age_days_firstDate,
    admission_age_days_lastDate,
    # demographics
    sex,
    age_admission_yr,
    # follow up and disease onset
    neonatal_onset,
    # genetic mutations
    other_epilepsy_mutations,
    recurrent_variant,
    # clinical history
    seizure_related_admission,
    length_of_stay_days,
    length_of_stay_days_cat,
    respiratory_support_admission,
    tech_assistance_ever,
    readmission,
    count_readmissions,
    exptime,
    # treatment history
    vns_insertion_ever,
    n_distinct_asm_admission,
    adverse_effect_admission,
    ketogenic_diet_admission,
    ketogenic_diet_at_admission_day,
    quinidine_admission,
    quinidine_at_admission_day
  ) %>%
  # arrange by patient uuid and admission day
  arrange(patient_uuid, admission_age_days_firstDate)
```

### Excluding outliers (only to LOHS)

```{r}
#| label: outlier-exclusion-df-sensitivity-analyses
#| echo: false

#' Definition (SAP) updated after checking an approximately log-normal distribution of LOHS
#' https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0031699725074575?ref=cra_js_challenge&fr=RR-1
#' Outliers will be identified based on the distribution of the log-transformed 
#' length of hospital stay (LOHS). 
#' Specifically, any value of log(LOHS) below the first quartile minus 1.5 times
#'  the interquartile range (IQR), or above the third quartile plus 1.5 × IQR,
#'   will be considered an outlier and excluded from the analysis.
#'    
#'    For this sensitivity analysis, we will start from the main df with all
#'     covariates

lohs_df_outliers <- hospitalization_main_df %>%
  filter(
    birth_admission == 0, # Exclude birth admissions
    planned_admission == 0, # Exclude planned admissions
    outpatient_admission == 0 # Exclude outpatient admissions
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    # patient identifier
    patient_uuid,
    # admissions related features
    admission_age_days_firstDate,
    admission_age_days_lastDate,
    # demographics
    sex,
    age_admission_yr,
    # follow up and disease onset
    neonatal_onset,
    # genetic mutations
    other_epilepsy_mutations,
    recurrent_variant,
    # clinical history
    seizure_related_admission,
    length_of_stay_days,
    respiratory_support_admission,
    tech_assistance_ever,
    # treatment history
    vns_insertion_ever,
    n_distinct_asm_admission,
    adverse_effect_admission,
    ketogenic_diet_admission,
    quinidine_admission
    ) %>%
  # add log(LOHS)
  mutate(log_lohs = log(length_of_stay_days)) 

# Compute IQR bounds on the LOG scale
Q1_log  <- quantile(lohs_df_outliers$log_lohs, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
Q3_log  <- quantile(lohs_df_outliers$log_lohs, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
IQR_log <- Q3_log - Q1_log

lower_log <- max(0, Q1_log - 1.5 * IQR_log)
upper_log <- Q3_log + 1.5 * IQR_log

# Filter rows by keeping ONLY observations within the LOG bounds
log_lohs_df_outliers <- lohs_df_outliers %>%
  filter(log_lohs >= lower_log, log_lohs <= upper_log) %>%
  dplyr::select(-log_lohs)
```
